decisions.quote: Our results first replicate key findings of Payne et al. (2005): we show that warning participants about the effect of the prime on subsequent judgements in the AMP does not eliminate or significantly mitigate the average AMP effect.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly state that their results replicate the key findings of Payne et al. (2005) regarding the basic and warning conditions, whereas the reduced average effect and heterogeneity under monetary incentives come from a novel extension condition not tested in the original study.
